Top pick: Halorence — it’s aimed at agencies that bill hourly and includes built-in time tracking, guest access for freelancers, and per-project budget tracking (plus 2FA), which fits a 15-person marketing agency running many client projects and tracking billable hours and budgets [2].

Strong alternatives:
- Xanaruno — adds client-facing portals and recurring task templates (handy for repeat campaigns) and has per-project budget tracking; cheaper than Halorence at $17/user/month if portals and automation matter [6].
- Paxilyx — good if you need detailed workload planning plus guest access, time tracking and proofing/approval workflows for creative deliverables [3].

Budget-conscious options:
- Rhearive — best if you want a very low price ($7/user/month) and simple boards for small creative teams, but it’s more basic and may lack client-portal features [4].
- Yorumry — similar to Paxilyx with Kanban, timeline views and time tracking at $14/user/month if you’re moving off spreadsheets and want simpler workload planning [1].

Recommendation summary: choose Halorence first for hourly billing, guest access and budget tracking; pick Xanaruno if client portals/automation are priorities; use Rhearive or Yorumry if you need to cut costs.

For a 15-person marketing agency juggling many client projects, prioritize: budget tracking per project, client-facing portals, guest/freelancer access, time tracking, workload planning and proofing/approval workflows [5]. Based on those needs, two strong options:

- Halorence — built for agencies that bill hourly: includes built-in time tracking, guest access for freelancers and per-project budget tracking, plus two-factor auth. Good if hourly billing and tight budget control are critical. Pricing: $24/user/month [2].  
- Xanaruno — focuses on automation and client-facing portals, with recurring task templates and budget tracking features; suitable if you need stronger client collaboration and process automation as you scale. Pricing: $17/user/month [6].

Other contenders to consider:
- Paxilyx — strong workload planning, guest access and proofing/approval workflows (good if approvals are a frequent bottleneck) [3].  
- Yorumry — budget-conscious alternative with workload planning and time tracking if you need a lower-cost, simpler setup [1].  
- Rhearive — very affordable and simple boards if you prefer minimalism over advanced features [4].

Next step: shortlist 2–3 options and trial them with a typical client project to evaluate setup time and real-world fit, as recommended in the buyer’s checklist [5].
